name: ecommerce-backend
description: E-commerce microservices backend (NestJS): API gateway + users, products, orders, notifications services

scripts.build: nest build api-gateway && nest build users-service && nest build products-service && nest build orders-service && nest build notifications-service
scripts.prisma:generate: prisma generate --schema apps/users-service/prisma/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema apps/products-service/prisma/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema apps/orders-service/prisma/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema apps/notifications-service/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:migrate: prisma migrate deploy --schema apps/users-service/prisma/schema.prisma && prisma migrate deploy --schema apps/products-service/prisma/schema.prisma && prisma migrate deploy --schema apps/orders-service/prisma/schema.prisma && prisma migrate deploy --schema apps/notifications-service/prisma/schema.prisma
